Sarah Lee: Heads-up — prospect (regulated fintech) wants an on‑prem, fully air‑gapped POC. Key asks: monthly security patches, offline installer, and a simple upgrade path. They also want pricing options for a 6‑month pilot.
Omar Khanna: Good to know. Do we have constraints from them on image size / allowed protocols? some gov clouds limit >500MB downloads.
Sarah Lee: They said installer must be <300MB and only allow HTTPS over a corporate proxy. No outbound auth to our registry.
Paul Garcia: We can produce an offline bundle (tarball) and a signed checksum. Typical tarball today is ~1.2GB because it contains model artifacts — so we need to provide a lightweight variant: runtime+loader only + separate model artifact staged manually.
Omar Khanna: If we separate model blobs, can we support incremental deltas for upgrades? Customer asked for monthly deltas rather than full reimages.
Paul Garcia: Yes — technical plan: split into three parts: 1) control plane binaries (small), 2) model weights (big, optionally stored on airgapped NFS), 3) runtime cache. We can ship delta patches for control plane via binary diffs (bsdiff) and provide rsync-like deltas for model shards. Need engineering signoff on automation.
Ritika Desai: Security Qs to answer for RFP — we must confirm: patch cadence (monthly + emergency CVE hotfix), KMS/HSM support for key material, support for customer-managed CA rotation, and ability to run with FIPS‑compatible crypto modules. Also need confirmation on our data-at-rest encryption and that no telemetry leaves the VPC.
Omar Khanna: For pricing, they asked: 6‑month pilot — fixed price for Dedicated Private vs committed monthly capacity. Can we offer a pilot SKU with lower commit + bill overages?
Sarah Lee: Sales wants a simple sheet: pilot flat fee, optional model serving units (MSUs) per hour, and overage rate. Add a line for professional services (airgap installation and onsite runbook).
Paul Garcia: Operational blockers to call out: DB schema migrations require brief downtime (can be done during maintenance window). Canary upgrades are supported but require rsync access between nodes for cache warming — not available in fully isolated mode unless they provide an internal transfer mechanism.
Ritika Desai: For the security questionnaire: draft answers I can provide — but need exact installer signing process and SHA256 checksums for each artifact, plus attestations for lack of telemetry. Also need legal to approve a Data Processing Addendum for on‑prem scenarios.
Sarah Lee: Action items: Omar — confirm pricing options + draft pilot SKU by EOD. Paul — outline packaging options (full bundle, split model + runtime, delta patch workflow) and include size estimates. Ritika — produce SQA answers for the RFP and list of additional docs legal will need. I'll coordinate with the customer for preferred OS (they currently run RHEL 8 / Rocky).
Omar Khanna: Will do. Also noted: they want upgrade cadence to be monthly for the pilot, but will consider quarterly for production. Put that in the pricing doc.

Sarah Lee: Thanks — linking this thread to the deal in CRM. I'll ping Solutions Eng on Tuesday for a dry run install. :thumbsup:
